objects.name: Analytic 2088
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies sh/bash/ash/zsh/BusyBox execution from an unexpected parent, unauthorized account, remote session, or non-approved script path, particularly when followed by OT-relevant network discovery, persistence, file modification, or communications. Alert only when the interpreter/shell is not expected for the asset role or user/service context, or when its parent, path, arguments, remote-session source, or follow-on behavior violates the approved OT baseline. Suppress approved engineering scripts, vendor support, diagnostics, backup, patching, and maintenance windows.
